## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

 Substantial shared phraseology also links this enquiry to several divisions of the *Aṅguttara Nikāya* (notably AN 5, AN 4, AN 3, and AN 10), the *Nidāna Saṁyutta* (SN 12), the *Indriya Saṁyutta* (SN 48), and the *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14) [DharmaNexus]. Furthermore, formulas and structural passages are frequently shared with other enquiries in the *Milindapañha*, including Mil 5.5.5, Mil 6.1.2, Mil 5.4.10, Mil 5.5.10, Mil 5.1.9, Mil 5.5.3, and Mil 5.2.2 [DharmaNexus]. Beyond the Pali corpus, DharmaNexus reports machine alignments with Sanskrit texts—specifically Kṣemendra's *Sumāgadhāvadāna* and Candrakīrti's *Prasannapadā*—and a segment in the Chinese *Ekottarika Āgama* (*Zengyi Ahan jing*, T 125) [DharmaNexus].

*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on catalog and DharmaNexus data.*
